test_title: PYST 26: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the sister of B’,

A @ B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A - B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

and A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is O related to V if ‘O - P # T @ G + V’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1887e263a0be106c3fc3bef05d4c58742c6a15e36b93bc74e9b8034e1f5d249.png]

Given Expression: O - P # T @ G + V

O - P → O is the wife of P.

P # T → P is the father of T.

T @ G → T is the brother of G.

G + V → G is the sister of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c48d5305df40a5604f601772c4919b084de3f5938ecb2d7175f9c58aef55fd1.png] 

Thus, O is V's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
